short: Kernel coefficient valuations from bounds on Frobenius orbits

lean.name: PI.OrbBoundFW.prvF_of_orbitLetterBounds
lean.plain: Kernel coefficient valuations from bounds on Frobenius orbits
lean.note: The jet estimates give a valuation lower bound orbit by orbit once the series meets the integrality and shape hypotheses. Indexing the variables along Frobenius orbits of CM embeddings gives a bound in terms of the orbit gain, its first correction, and a loss.
